This is perfume is beautiful and smells so clean and fresh! However, For everyone saying this doesn’t last, it’s because it’s eau de toilette! Not eau de parfum!! I’m actually not a huge fan of most Chanel fragrances. I find them too sharp but that could also be my inexperienced nose. However I first tried this as a sample and just purchase a bottle because I loved it so much.

I’m the worst at explaining scents so I’ll stick to what I know. 

I prefer this fragrance more in warmer weather because it’s not cozy, rather more playful and fun, yet sophisticated. I also prefer this during the day as I feel the sunshine compliments the fragrance much more, however in the evening it’s nice, just not preference.

I can wear this with a revealing warm-weather outfit, to a casual or more moderate outfit, as well as with a more professional look and it compliments all of them well. 

I think it smells like a youthful woman who has a full time job, trying to get her ish together, but also likes going out once in a while, and flirts around without being provocative. 

I’m 23 however I feel as though this could compliment a younger girl if she wanted to appear more strong and confident, and it could compliment older women if they wanted to appear more playful.

Though I think anyone should wear whatever they want, I think if someone who enjoys earthy scents were to try this, they may not like it. 

I don’t think it’s offensive at all but it’s not boring either. I’ve received compliments but no one says “oh you’re wearing chance” unlike when I wear light blue or Flowerbomb for example, everyone knows those scents as if they’ve smelled it a million times (though I still enjoy wearing them). 

Also, the lasting power is actually quite phenomenal on me considering it’s not even an edp. Someone mentioned it faded quickly but I can still smell it on myself 4 hours later, and others can smell it on me 8 hours after application (but I can’t smell it on myself).

I don't usually wear red lip color; it's only been in recent years that I've delved into red lipsticks. I wondered if this lip gloss might be easier to wear on a daily basis and decided to give it a try. At $13 (even less on sale), it was worth giving a shot. This is my honest and authentic opinion as a Sephora Beauty Insider Community Ambassador. 

The wand has a curved, doe-foot applicator with a pointed tip, with a slight dip in the applicator, to collect the product and allow it to hug the curves of your lips as you sweep the color across them. Applicator is smaller than most but works just fine. The pointed tips makes it convenient for lining or going over the perimeter of the lips, particular the top half. Well designed.

The color is beautiful. I’m always a little concerned that pinky reds like this one will turn fuchsia on me - fuchsia is a beautiful color but it does not suit me as a lip color. This stayed true to the color in the tube, if slightly more pink than what you see in photos. 

The gloss has a medium thickness to it and a slight tack, which is to be expected. Neither the thickness or tack were as prevalent as you would find in a vinyl lacquer or a MAC gloss or a Dior lip oil, but it is noticeable. It delivers a beautiful shine too. As for its plumping claims, I don't experience any tingling like I might with other products that claim to plump my lips; even so, my lips do look a little fuller, more plumpy.

Being a gloss, longevity will not be endless. This wasn’t bad though. Even with sipping on water and coffee throughout the morning, the color lasted for few hours, though the color fades as the hours wear on. The gloss wore comfortably throughout that time - my lips felt moisturized and hydrated. 

Great for a little pizzazz on the weekends, or over a lipstick for some extra oomph, or to add a lovely hint of color before a last-minute videoconference call or meeting. A beauty for those new to reds as well as lifetime red lip lovers.
